description: Tool to list all audience exports for a property. Use when you need to find and reuse existing audience exports rather than creating new ones.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing AudienceExports on a Google Analytics property.

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of audience exports to return. Default: 200, Maximum: 1000
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. Token from a previous response for pagination to retrieve the next page of results
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. Property identifier in format 'properties/{propertyId}'. Example: 'properties/489591273'
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: ListAudienceExportsRequest

name: list_audience_exports

AudienceDimension.description: Schema for an AudienceDimension included in the export.

dimensionName.description: API name of the dimension, e.g., 'country', 'city', 'deviceCategory'
dimensionName.title: Dimension Name

AudienceDimension.title: AudienceDimension

creationQuotaTokensCharged.description: Total quota tokens consumed during creation
creationQuotaTokensCharged.title: Creation Quota Tokens Charged

dimensions.description: Array of dimensions representing requested user attributes
dimensions.title: Dimensions

errorMessage.description: Failure explanation if state is FAILED
errorMessage.title: Error Message

rowCount.description: Total rows in the export result
rowCount.title: Row Count

state.description: Current status: STATE_UNSPECIFIED, CREATING, ACTIVE, or FAILED
state.title: State

audienceExports.description: Collection of AudienceExport objects for the property
audienceExports.title: Audience Exports

nextPageToken.description: Token for retrieving next page. Omitted if no more pages exist
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token
